facts.text: The University of Dayton provides guaranteed net tuition for each year in an admitted student's financial aid offer, ensuring tuition will not change unexpectedly over four years.

sources.title: Four-Year Approach to Tuition : University of Dayton, Ohio
sources.quote: The net tuition for each year in your financial aid offer is guaranteed, so you'll never have to worry about unexpected tuition increases because you have the information upfront.
